workouts.summary: Wake up your fingertips, then work rhythm and change of direction at game speed with your eyes up.

drills.name: Fingertip Wake-Up
drills.summary: Quick, hard dribbles at three heights to lock in control with both hands.
steps: Dribble at ankle height with your right hand for 20 seconds.
Move up to knee height, then waist height, 20 seconds each.
Switch to your left hand and repeat all three heights.
Keep your eyes on a spot across the street the whole time.

drills.name: Between-Legs Rocker
drills.summary: Rock your weight forward and back while you go between your legs, then attack.
steps: Get in a staggered stance, left foot forward.
Dribble between your legs, front to back, and rock your hips back.
Go back through and rock forward like you are about to drive.
After four rocks, explode out for three hard dribbles.
Switch feet and repeat.

drills.name: Shuffle Cross Attack
drills.summary: Hit a quick crossover off a shuffle step and burst out low at game speed.
steps: Start at one end of the driveway in a low stance.
Take two shuffle steps with a live dribble.
Snap a low crossover and push out with two long dribbles.
Turn around and come back the other way, starting with your other hand.
Go 75% speed first, then full speed once it is clean.

workouts.summary: Study film like a point guard: why turnovers happen, how guards beat pressure, and when the extra pass wins.

drills.name: Film: Turnover Breakdown
drills.equipment: Game film on a phone or laptop
drills.summary: Watch 10 minutes of game film and study every turnover.
steps: Watch 10 minutes of game film and watch only turnovers.
Pause after each one and rewind five seconds.
Say out loud what caused it: bad pass, bad read, or pressure.
Say what the guard should have done instead.
Write one or two takeaways in your notebook.

drills.name: Film: Press Break Reads
drills.equipment: Game film on a phone or laptop
drills.summary: Watch 10 minutes of game film and study how guards beat full-court pressure.
steps: Find a game where a team presses, or any inbound under pressure.
Watch where the guard gets open to catch the inbound.
Pause when the trap comes and say where the open pass is.
Notice if the guard beats it with the pass or the dribble.
Write one or two takeaways in your notebook.

drills.name: Film: The Extra Pass
drills.equipment: Game film on a phone or laptop
drills.summary: Watch 10 minutes of game film and study when a good shot turns into a great one.
steps: Watch 10 minutes of game film and watch the ball on every drive.
Pause when a player catches with a defender running at them.
Say out loud: shoot, or make the extra pass?
Play it and see who was open one pass away.
Write one or two takeaways in your notebook.

workouts.summary: Finish with your off hand, off the wrong foot, and with a soft scoop at game speed.

drills.name: Off-Hand Only Layups
drills.summary: Build trust in your weak hand with layups from both sides.
steps: Start at the left elbow and drive for a left-hand layup.
Use the glass and the top corner of the box.
Rebound and do 5 makes, then go to the right side.
Use your left hand on the right side too, finishing on the front of the rim.

drills.name: Between-Legs Drive Prep
drills.summary: Set up the drive with a between-the-legs dribble and attack the rim in two dribbles.
steps: Start at the three-point line on the wing.
Hit a between-the-legs dribble to switch hands.
Attack with two hard dribbles to the rim and finish.
Alternate wings and starting hands each rep.

drills.name: Scoop Layup Series
drills.summary: Finish under a shot blocker with an underhand scoop off the glass.
steps: Drive from the wing at 75% speed.
Take the ball low on your gather and keep it away from the rim side.
Scoop it underhand, palm up, high off the glass.
Go 5 makes each side, then go full speed.

drills.name: Wrong-Foot Finishes
drills.summary: Jump off the unexpected foot to throw off the shot blocker's timing.
steps: Drive from the right wing toward the rim.
Jump off your right foot and finish with your right hand.
Do 4 makes, then switch to the left side, left foot, left hand.
Once it feels smooth, go game speed.

workouts.summary: Groove your release close in, then build clean catch footwork and an escape dribble jumper.

drills.name: Swish Ladder
drills.summary: Move back one step only after a swish to tune your arc and release.
steps: Start one step in front of the rim.
Shoot until you make one that touches nothing but net.
Take one step back after each swish.
Stop at the free throw line and start over.

drills.name: Catch Footwork Series
drills.summary: Shoot off a hop catch and a 1-2 step catch from the same spots.
steps: Toss the ball out in front of you with backspin, or have a rebounder pass.
Catch on a hop, landing on both feet at once, and shoot.
Next rep, catch with a 1-2 step, inside foot first, and shoot.
Shoot from five spots around the mid-range.
Track your makes for each footwork.

drills.name: Escape Dribble Jumpers
drills.summary: Create space with one dribble away from the defense and rise up.
steps: Start at the elbow facing the rim.
Take one hard dribble sideways toward the wing.
Plant, square your shoulders, and shoot.
Go 5 shots to each side.
Once it is clean, start from a jab step at game speed.

workouts.summary: Build a stance that lasts, pressure the ball with your hands, and turn the ball handler down the sideline.

drills.name: Hot Feet Stance
drills.summary: Hold a low stance with fast feet and active hands.
steps: Get in a wide stance, chest up, hips low.
Chop your feet fast for 20 seconds.
On your own call, slide two steps right, then two left.
Rest 10 seconds and go again.

drills.name: Ball Pressure Hands
drills.summary: Trace the ball with your hands without reaching or fouling.
steps: Partner holds the ball in triple threat and moves it around.
You stay an arm's length away in your stance.
Follow the ball with your hand without touching your partner.
If they bring the ball low, keep your feet and do not lunge.
Switch roles every 40 seconds.

drills.name: Sideline Funnel
drills.summary: Turn the ball handler toward the sideline and keep them out of the middle.
steps: Partner dribbles in a lane between the sideline and the top of the key.
Set your top foot high to take away the middle.
Slide and stay level with their hip as they go.
Partner goes 50% at first, then game speed.
Switch roles after each trip down the floor.

workouts.summary: Build a guard's engine with dribble tempo work, cone footwork, a stance burner, and full-court push repeats.

drills.name: Tempo Dribble Laps
drills.summary: Change speeds with the ball around the court to warm up your engine.
steps: Dribble around the outside of the court.
Go 75% on the sidelines and full speed on the baselines.
Switch hands each time you turn a corner.
Keep going for the full time.

drills.name: Box Cone Footwork
drills.summary: Sprint, slide, backpedal and slide around a square of cones.
steps: Set 4 cones in a square about 5 steps apart.
Sprint forward to the first cone.
Slide to the second, backpedal to the third, slide back to the start.
Go 20 seconds on, 10 seconds rest.
Switch directions every round.

drills.name: Stance Burner
drills.summary: Hold a defensive stance with fast feet while tired.
steps: Get in a low stance on the baseline.
Chop your feet for 15 seconds.
Sprint to the free throw line and back.
Drop right back into your stance and repeat.

drills.name: Full-Court Push Repeats
drills.summary: Push the ball end to end at full speed and finish with a layup.
steps: Start under one hoop with the ball.
Dribble full speed to the other end and finish a layup.
Grab the ball and jog back on the sideline.
Rest 15 seconds, then go again.
Alternate hands each trip.

beginner.summary: Simple control dribbles with both hands and your eyes up, one move at a time.

drills.name: Knee-High Control Dribbles
drills.summary: Own a steady knee-high dribble with each hand.
steps: Get in a low stance with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Dribble at knee height with your right hand for 30 seconds.
Switch to your left hand for 30 seconds.
Repeat both hands. Keep your eyes on a spot ahead of you.

drills.name: Front Crossover Freeze
drills.summary: Cross the ball low and quick, then freeze in control.
steps: Start with a right-hand dribble in your stance.
Cross the ball low to your left hand.
Freeze for one dribble and check your balance.
Cross back to your right hand and freeze again.
Keep going at a controlled speed.

drills.name: Driveway Line Dribbles
drills.equipment: 1 ball, a line or crack on the driveway
drills.summary: Walk a straight line while dribbling, changing hands at the end.
steps: Pick a line about 10 steps long.
Walk the line dribbling with your right hand.
At the end, cross to your left hand and walk back.
After 60 seconds, speed up to a light jog.
Keep the ball beside your hip, not in front.

beginner.summary: Watch one point guard closely and learn what they see and who gets back.

drills.name: Film: Point Guard's Eyes
drills.equipment: Game film on a phone or laptop
drills.summary: Watch 10 minutes of game film and watch where one point guard looks.
steps: Pick one point guard and only watch them.
Each time they bring the ball up, notice where their eyes go first.
Pause after a pass and say out loud what they saw.
Count how often they look up the floor before dribbling.
Write one or two takeaways in your notebook.

drills.name: Film: Who Gets Back
drills.equipment: Game film on a phone or laptop
drills.summary: Watch 10 minutes of game film and watch who sprints back after a shot.
steps: Watch the moment a shot goes up.
Watch the guards, not the ball.
Pause and say out loud who ran back first.
Notice who stays to rebound and who gets beaten down the floor.
Write one or two takeaways in your notebook.

beginner.summary: Clean layup footwork with both hands, adding one and then two dribbles.

drills.name: One-Dribble Layups
drills.summary: One dribble, two steps, soft layup off the glass.
steps: Start at the block, facing the hoop at an angle.
Take one dribble and step right-left for a right-hand layup.
Rebound and go to the left side.
Step left-right for a left-hand layup.
Alternate sides each rep.

drills.name: Backboard Square Finishes
drills.summary: Aim for the top corner of the square every time.
steps: Start on the wing, three dribbles from the hoop.
Drive in and lay it off the top corner of the square.
Use your right hand on the right side.
Use your left hand on the left side.
Count how many you make each minute.

drills.name: Cone Drive Layups
drills.summary: Drive past a cone and finish under control.
steps: Place a cone at the top of the key.
Start beyond the three-point line and dribble to the cone.
Go past the cone with your right hand and finish right.
Next rep, go left and finish left.
Keep your speed controlled, not all-out.

beginner.summary: Build a simple, repeatable shot close to the hoop before stepping out.

drills.name: Bank Shot Basics
drills.summary: Short bank shots from each side of the block.
steps: Stand one step off the right block at a 45-degree angle.
Shoot off the top corner of the square.
Hold your follow-through until it drops.
Do 5 makes, then switch to the left block.

drills.name: Elbow Hold Finish
drills.summary: Shoot from the elbows and freeze your finish every shot.
steps: Start at the right elbow, feet set, toes to the rim.
Shoot and hold your arm up until the ball lands.
Check: fingers pointing at the rim, wrist relaxed.
Rebound or get a pass, then go to the left elbow.
Alternate elbows each shot.

drills.name: Step-In Catch Shots
drills.summary: Step into the catch so your feet are ready to shoot.
steps: Stand a big step behind a spot near the free throw line.
Toss the ball out with backspin, or get a pass from your rebounder.
Step in with a 1-2 step as you catch.
Rise and shoot in one motion.
Move to a new spot every 3 shots.

beginner.summary: Hold a strong stance, then slide and stay in front at a walking pace.

drills.name: Stance Hold Countdown
drills.summary: Hold a perfect defensive stance and build leg strength.
steps: Set your feet wider than your shoulders.
Bend your knees, chest up, hands out.
Hold for 20 seconds, then stand and rest 10.
Repeat the hold four times.
On each hold, add small quick foot taps.

drills.name: Partner Point Slides
drills.summary: Slide the way your partner points without crossing your feet.
steps: Get in stance facing your partner, 10 feet apart.
Partner points left or right.
Slide 3 steps that way and stop in stance.
Partner points again. Go for 30 seconds, then switch.
Never let your feet touch or cross.

drills.name: Walk-Up Contain
drills.summary: Stay in front of a slow dribbler from the top of the key to the baseline.
steps: Partner starts at the top of the key with the ball.
You start in stance an arm's length away.
Partner dribbles at a walk, zig-zagging toward the baseline.
Slide to stay in front, chest square to them.
Switch roles each trip. No reaching.

beginner.summary: Short bursts of running and dribbling with rest between, building guard fitness.

drills.name: Baseline Touch Sprints
drills.summary: Sprint to the free throw line and back with short rest.
steps: Start on the baseline.
Sprint to the free throw line and touch it with your hand.
Sprint back and touch the baseline.
Rest 10 seconds, then go again.
Run under control and stop with bent knees.

drills.name: Cone Weave Runs
drills.summary: Run around cones with quick turns and short rest.
steps: Set 4 cones in a line, 5 big steps apart.
Weave through the cones down and back at a jog.
Next trip, run faster with short choppy steps at each cone.
Rest 15 seconds between trips.

drills.name: Dribble Out-and-Backs
drills.summary: Speed dribble to half court and back with both hands.
steps: Start on the baseline with the ball.
Speed dribble with your right hand to half court.
Jump stop, pivot, and dribble back with your left hand.
Rest 15 seconds, then repeat.
Push the ball out in front as you run.

advanced.summary: Change heights, snatch back, and chain double moves, then finish with combos while tired.

drills.name: Three-Height Control
drills.summary: Own the ball at ankle, knee and shoulder height with either hand.
steps: Dribble right hand at ankle height for 10 hard pounds.
Move to knee height, then shoulder height, 10 each.
Switch to your left hand and repeat all three heights.
Finish by changing height every 3 dribbles without stopping.

drills.name: Snatch-Back Crossovers
drills.summary: Attack, snatch back two dribbles, then cross and go.
steps: Attack forward three hard dribbles at game speed.
Snatch the ball back with two quick retreat dribbles.
Hit a low, wide crossover and explode forward.
Go the length of the driveway and back.
Repeat starting with your left hand.

drills.name: Double-Move Chains
drills.summary: Link two moves together so the second one beats the help.
steps: Pick a chain: hesi to cross, in-and-out to between, or behind to spin.
Start at half speed and hit both moves clean.
Build to full speed by the third rep.
Do 5 reps of each chain, both directions.
Make one rep of each chain your fastest ever.

drills.name: Burnout Combo Clock
drills.summary: Handle the ball clean after a sprint, like the fourth quarter.
steps: Sprint the length of the driveway and back while dribbling.
Stop and hit 20 seconds of nonstop combo moves in place.
Use your weak hand to lead every second round.
Rest 10 seconds, then go again.
Count your fumbles and beat that number next week.

advanced.summary: Study how guards beat traps, manage the clock and chain reads off one drive.

drills.name: Film: Beat the Blitz
drills.equipment: Game film on a phone or laptop
drills.summary: Watch how a guard escapes a trap and finds the 4-on-3.
steps: Watch 10 minutes of game film and find every ball screen that gets trapped.
Pause when two defenders hit the ball and say where the open man is.
Watch whether the guard retreats, splits or passes early.
Track the screener: does he pop, roll or short-roll?
Write two takeaways on beating a trap in your notebook.

drills.name: Film: End-of-Quarter Clock
drills.equipment: Game film on a phone or laptop
drills.summary: Learn how guards use the clock for 2-for-1s and last shots.
steps: Watch the last minute of several quarters from college or pro games.
Pause at 40 seconds and say: 2-for-1 or hold for one?
Note when the guard starts the attack and who gets the shot.
Watch fouls up or down late and how the guard handles them.
Write one rule for the clock in your notebook.

drills.name: Film: Drive and Kick Chains
drills.equipment: Game film on a phone or laptop
drills.summary: Track three reads off one drive: help, kick and swing.
steps: Watch 10 minutes of game film and focus on every paint touch.
Pause as help steps over and name the open shooter.
Watch if the next pass is a shot, a swing or another drive.
Count how many passes it takes to get a great shot.
Write two notes on where help came from in your notebook.

advanced.summary: Finish through contact, split gaps and score both hands at game speed while tired.

drills.name: Off-Arm Shield Finishes
drills.summary: Protect the ball with your off arm and finish high off glass.
steps: Set a cone at the elbow as the help defender.
Drive past the cone and raise your off arm to create space.
Finish high off the glass with your outside hand.
Do 6 reps right side, then 6 reps left side.
Keep the off arm bent, never push off.

drills.name: Gap Split Finishes
drills.summary: Split two defenders low and finish before help recovers.
steps: Set two cones a step apart at the top of the key.
Attack the gap with a low crossover or between-the-legs.
Turn the corner tight and finish with either hand.
Mix layups, reverses and floaters each rep.
Go full speed every rep.

drills.name: Spin-Gather Finishes
drills.summary: Spin off a help defender and gather balanced for a finish.
steps: Drive from the wing at a cone placed in the lane.
Plant and spin away from the cone with the ball tight.
Gather on two feet or one foot and finish off glass.
Alternate sides each rep.
Add a fake after the spin on the last 6 reps.

drills.name: Tired Legs Rim Runs
drills.summary: Score the rim after sprints, alternating hands every finish.
steps: Sprint dribble from half court and finish right hand.
Grab the ball, sprint to half court and back the other way.
Finish left hand on the next rep.
Keep going for 60 seconds, then rest 15 seconds.
Count makes each round and try to match your first round.

advanced.summary: Groove your rhythm, then shoot on the move, off the hang and under make-pressure.

drills.name: Hop-Rhythm Warm-Up Shots
drills.summary: Lock in your rhythm with a hop into every shot.
steps: Start 8 feet from the rim on the right block.
Toss the ball out, hop into the catch and shoot.
Hit 3 makes, then step back to 12 feet.
Move around the arc at both distances.

drills.name: Five-Spot Movement Threes
drills.summary: Sprint between five spots and shoot threes on the catch.
steps: Start in the right corner and shoot one three.
Sprint to the right wing, catch or self-pass, shoot.
Keep moving: top, left wing, left corner.
Go back the other way without stopping.
Track makes out of 10 each round.

drills.name: Hang-Dribble Pull-Ups
drills.summary: Freeze the defender with a hang, then rise into a pull-up.
steps: Attack from the top at game speed.
Hang one dribble high and sell the drive.
Pick it up on a hard one-two stop and pull up at the elbow.
Alternate going right and left.
Move out to the three-point line after 10 makes.

drills.name: Pressure Make Streaks
drills.summary: Make three in a row from each spot or sprint for it.
steps: Pick five spots around the three-point line.
Make 3 in a row from a spot before you move.
Miss and you sprint to half court and back.
Mix catch-and-shoot and one-dribble pull-ups.
Finish with 2 free throws, both must go.

advanced.summary: Recover fast, contest under control, and win live battles against a partner.

drills.name: Heel-Turn Recovery Slides
drills.summary: Slide, turn and run when beat, then get back in stance.
steps: Slide hard for three steps between two cones.
Open your hips and sprint two steps like you got beat.
Plant and drop back into a low stance.
Go both directions and repeat.
Keep your chest up the whole time.

drills.name: Chop-Stop Contests
drills.summary: Sprint out, chop your feet, contest high and stay balanced.
steps: Start under the rim and sprint to a cone at the arc.
Chop your feet the last three steps.
Contest with a high hand, then slide to cut off a drive.
Back-pedal to the rim and go to the next cone.
Hit five cones around the arc each round.

drills.name: Full-Court Turn Battles
drills.summary: Turn a live dribbler full court and make him change direction.
steps: Partner dribbles up the court at full speed from the baseline.
Stay a half step ahead and force a turn every few dribbles.
Use your feet, not your hands.
Go to half court, then switch roles.
Count how many times you turn them each trip.

drills.name: Catch-and-Attack Defense
drills.summary: Close out to a live catch and contain the drive for three dribbles.
steps: Start under the rim, partner at the wing.
Toss the ball to your partner and close out.
Partner shoots, drives, or fakes and drives.
Contain for three dribbles and contest any shot.
Play 6 reps each, then switch roles.

advanced.summary: Build game-speed lungs with sprint builds, stance relays and timed full-court repeats.

drills.name: Baseline-to-Free-Throw Builds
drills.summary: Build speed with short sprints that get faster each rep.
steps: Sprint from baseline to the free throw line and back.
Next rep go to half court and back.
Next rep go to the far free throw line and back.
Walk 15 seconds, then repeat the set.

drills.name: Wall-to-Wall Stance Relays
drills.summary: Hold a game stance while slides and sprints wear you down.
steps: Slide from the baseline to the free throw line.
Sprint to half court.
Back-pedal to the far free throw line and slide to the baseline.
Rest 15 seconds and go back the other way.

drills.name: Three-Lane Dribble Sprints
drills.summary: Sprint dribble in every lane like a fast break.
steps: Set cones in the left lane, middle and right lane at both baselines.
Sprint dribble down the left lane and back up the middle.
Then go down the right lane and back up the middle.
Rest 20 seconds and repeat.
Switch dribble hands every lane.

drills.name: 22-Second Repeats
drills.summary: Run baseline to baseline twice in 22 seconds, over and over.
steps: Start on the baseline and sprint to the far baseline and back, twice.
Finish in 22 seconds or less.
Rest for 30 seconds.
Repeat as many times as you can in the time.
Count how many you make under 22.
